title: I built this little demolition game
author: Gloomy_Option205
selftext:
It has  
 \- Operate a full-size wrecking crane  
 \- Swing the wrecking ball with real physics  
 \- Tear down destructible structures piece by piece  
 \- Debris, collisions and destruction all simulated in real time  
  
It’s playable little game with interacting systems, physics and destruction.  
  
Still an early build. I used Rez 1, exclusive model on Rezona Lab
